      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nameAvailable == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies">

rules.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all follow the same preceding event and are performed together, and a later step continues only after all of them are done: Model an opening parallel gateway after the preceding step, with one branch per listed activity, and close those branches with a joining parallel gateway before the next step. Do not chain the activities in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway to join them.
rules.situation: the description introduces two or more activities that the participant can begin together, with no stated order between them, and a later sentence says they must be finished before a shared continuation

rules.instruction: When the description states, in one sentence, several items that the same participant enters or selects, joined by commas or 'and', and each item is a distinct input or choice the participant makes: Model each item in that list as its own user task, in the order the sentence states them, and label each task with the verb and the single item it covers, taken from the description. Do not combine two items into one task label, and do not drop any item from the list.
rules.situation: the description states, in one sentence, several items that the same participant enters or selects, joined by commas or 'and', and each item is a distinct input or choice the participant makes

rules.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all belong to one stage, have no stated order between them, and a later step waits until every one of them has finished: Model each listed activity as its own task. Open the branches with a parallel gateway placed before the first of these tasks, and close them with a matching parallel gateway placed before the next step. Do not sequence the tasks unless the description states an order, and do not merge them into one task.
rules.situation: the description lists several activities of the same actor with no stated order between them, and a later step continues only after all of them are done

rules.instruction: When the description states that several distinct actions are carried out in parallel (for example, items are sent in parallel), or that a set of distinct actions must all be completed before the process continues: Model a parallel gateway that forks into one outgoing branch per action, so that all branches start, and a parallel gateway that joins those branches before the next step. Do not model the set as a single task, and do not use an exclusive gateway to merge branches that must all complete.
rules.situation: the description lists two or more actions that must all be done, joined by 'and' or a list, with no order stated between them, and the process continues only after all of them are finished

rules.instruction: When the description states that a decision checks whether the participant already holds a prerequisite, and that on the outcome where it is not held, the participant must first supply details and then complete a verification step before the flow continues: On the outcome of that decision where the prerequisite is missing, model the supplying of details as its own user task and the verification step as a separate, following user task, in the order the description gives, placed between the gateway outcome and the next step. Do not connect the gateway directly to the verification task, and do not fold the supplying of details into the gateway label or the verification task's label.
rules.situation: the description states that a decision checks whether the participant already holds a prerequisite, and that on the outcome where it is not held, the participant must first supply details and then complete a verification step before the flow continues
